flags.issue: Serious spec conflict about maximum temperature, and the brand side disagrees with itself. The Amazon listing (S29, re-read 2026-11-16 through the supplied short link) says 450 °F Hi-Fry, 4-in-1 (bake/dehydrate/frozen). One brand page and its manual — the TurboFry Touch Stainless (RJ38-SQSS-8T, S12/S13) — document 200–400 °F with four food-type presets. But Chefman's other 8 Qt page, TurboFry 8 Qt w/ High Fry (RJ38-8T-BLACK, S26, re-read live 2026-11-16), states a 450 °F Hi-Fry button and a 450 °F / 232 °C Hi-Fry temperature, matching the listing. Two different Chefman 8 Qt models are therefore in play; which model the ASIN maps to is unconfirmed (question Q-01).
flags.action: Conflicting claims shown side by side; no value asserted. Narrowed 2026-11-16 by session arena/ba29c641: the listing's own spec table states a 400 °F maximum and its Part Number identifies RJ38-SQSS-8T, so the 450 °F wording now conflicts with the page it appears on as well as with the brand documents - and because a second Chefman 8 Qt page does document 450 °F Hi-Fry (S26), the two-models explanation stays open alongside the stale-title one. Neither is asserted. What a buyer should do is read the manual in the box; what would settle it is a statement from Chefman about which SKU sits behind the ASIN. See F33 and F68.
